relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: in vitro IL-1β up-regulated Nav1.8 expression in DRG neurons cultured from young but not old rats

relationships.subject: TNF-α
relationships.evidence_quote: while TNF-α up-regulated ASIC3 expression in both age groups

relationships.subject: A803467
relationships.evidence_quote: selective blockade of Nav1.8 with A803467 or of ASIC3 with APETx2 alleviated mechanical and cold allodynia and also spontaneous pain in both age groups with slightly different potency

relationships.subject: APETx2
relationships.evidence_quote: selective blockade of Nav1.8 with A803467 or of ASIC3 with APETx2 alleviated mechanical and cold allodynia and also spontaneous pain in both age groups with slightly different potency

key_findings: Aged female rats show delayed recovery from inflammatory mechanical allodynia; ASIC3 stays elevated only in aged rats.
Blocking Nav1.8 or ASIC3 relieves pain in both ages; cytokine regulation of Nav1.8/ASIC3 expression is age-dependent.
